difficulty_reason: Quasi-coherence along a stackification: reduces to the case where Y is the stackification of X, takes the first assertion from lemma-stackification together with O_X = f^{-1}O_Y, and proves the nontrivial converse (f^*G quasi-coherent forces G quasi-coherent) by testing on an object y, covering it by objects y_i coming from X, using that x_i^*f^*G = y_i^*G on (Sch/U_i)_fppf and finishing with Modules on Sites, local-final-object plus lemma-characterize-quasi-coherent. Retained author proof at lines 2209-2233.
